hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Ibn Abbas: Moses addressed the Children of Israel and said: 'No one is more knowledgeable about Allah and His command than me.' So he was commanded to meet this man, meaning al-Khidr.

hadiths.arabicText: أنا مَعْمَرٌ , عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ , عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ , عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ , قَالَ : خَطَبَ مُوسَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ , فَقَالَ : " مَا أَحَدٌ أَعْلَمَ بِاللَّهِ وَبِأَمْرِهِ مِنِّي ، فَأُمِرَ أَنْ يَلْقَى هَذَا الرَّجُلَ " ، يَعْنِي الْخَضِرَ

hadiths.english_translation: Qatadah said: It was said to him (Moses): 'Indeed, the sign of your meeting him is that you will forget some of your provisions. So he and his servant Yusha' ibn Nun set out, and they took a salted fish as provision. When they reached where Allah willed, Allah restored the soul to the fish, and it made its way into the sea...' (continuing the story of Moses and the fish).

hadiths.arabicText: أرنا مَعْمَرٌ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، أَنَّهُ قِيلَ لَهُ : " إِنَّ آيَةَ لُقِيِّكَ إِيَّاهُ ، أَنْ تَنْسَى بَعْضَ مَتَاعِكَ ، فَخَرَجَ هُوَ وَفَتَاهُ يُوشَعُ بْنُ نُونٍ ، وَتَزَوَّدُوا حُوتًا مَمْلُوحًا ، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَا حَيْثُ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ، رَدَّ اللَّهُ إِلَى الْحُوتِ رُوحَهُ ، فَسَرَبَ فِي الْبَحْرِ...

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Ibn Abbas: When Moses followed the trace of the fish, he reached a man who was sleeping, covered with his garment. Moses greeted him with salam, and the man uncovered his face from the garment and returned the salam. Then he said to Moses: 'Who are you?' He said: 'I am Moses.' He said: 'The one of the Children of Israel?' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Did you not have enough occupation with the Children of Israel?' He said: 'Indeed, but I was commanded to come to you and accompany you.' He said: 'Indeed you will not be able to have patience with me' (Surah Al-Kahf 18:67)...' (continuing with the story of Moses and al-Khidr).

hadiths.arabicText: أرنا مَعْمَرٌ , عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ , عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ , عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ , قَالَ : " لَمَّا اقْتَفَى مُوسَى أَثَرَ الْحُوتِ ، انْتَهَى إِلَى رَجُلٍ رَاقِدٍ وَقَدْ سَجَّى عَلَيْهِ ثَوْبَهُ...

hadiths.english_translation: Tawus said: A man bought wine and carried it to the land of India. When he approached them, he poured water equal to it upon it, then sold it, and put its price in a pouch, then tied it to a mast. Then they sailed. There was a monkey with them on the ship, so the monkey climbed until it reached the top of the mast, then took the pouch and opened it, and began throwing one dirham in the ship and one dirham in the sea until it finished all of it.

hadiths.arabicText: أرنا مَعْمَرٌ , عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ : " أَنَّ رَجُلا ابْتَاعَ خَمْرًا ، وَحَمَلَهُ إِلَى أَرْضِ الْهِنْدِ...

hadiths.english_translation: Ma'mar said, and Qatadah said: 'In front of them. Do you not see that He says: Behind them is Hell (Surah Al-Jathiyah 45:10).' And in the recitation of Ibn Mas'ud: 'And there was behind them a king who would seize every sound ship by force.' As for the boy, he was a disbeliever. And in the recitation of Ubayy ibn Ka'b: 'And his parents were believers, so We intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and closer in affection' (Surah Al-Kahf 18:81): meaning 'more dutiful to his parents.' 'And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and beneath it was a treasure belonging to them' (Surah Al-Kahf 18:82). He said: 'Wealth belonging to them.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَقَالَ مَعْمَرٌ , وَقَالَ قَتَادَةُ : " أَمَامَهُمْ أَلا تَرَى أَنَّهُ يَقُولُ : مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ...

hadiths.english_translation: Qatadah said: 'The treasure (kanz) was permissible for those before us, but prohibited for us. And booty (ghanimah) was prohibited for those before us, but made permissible for us.'
